title: Senior Product Manager, Secret Detection and Vulnerability Research
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 
 An overview of this role
 As a Senior Product Manager , you will own GitLab's Secret Detection offering and the Vulnerability Research function that produces the detection content across security products. Secret Detection is one of the highest-signal, highest-volume security capabilities on the platform. Leaked credentials are the most common initial access vector in real breaches, and as AI agents write, commit, and configure more of the software, the surface area for exposed secrets grows faster than the number of humans watching it.
 You will own the full loop: detect a secret with high precision, tell the customer whether it is still live, get it revoked, and prevent the next one from ever landing. In parallel, you will own vulnerability research as a product asset rather than a back-office function. The detection rules, advisory data, and malicious package and reference intelligence your team produces are what make GitLab's security scanners worth paying for, and they need to ship on a cadence with measurable quality.
 This is an outcome-owning role - you will carry adoption, retention, and revenue targets for your area and be expected to explain how your roadmap moves them.
 Some examples of our projects: 
 Push protection and pre-receive blocking that stops a credential before it reaches a repository, without wrecking developer flow
 Secret validity checking and automated revocation partnerships with major cloud and SaaS token issuers
 Detection content pipelines that turn threat research into shipped rules, with precision and recall tracked per rule
 Intelligence-driven detection of malicious packages, dependencies, and references entering the software supply chain
 What you'll do
 Own the business outcomes for Secret Detection and Vulnerability Research, including adoption, expansion, competitive win rate, and revenue contribution. Bring a point of view on packaging and pricing, not just features.
 Set the strategy for the full secret lifecycle: prevention, detection, validation, revocation, and reporting across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed.
 Treat detection content as a product. Define how rules, advisories, and intelligence feeds are sourced, validated, versioned, and measured, and make quality visible to customers.
 Hold the line on detection quality. False positives are a product defect and you will own the metrics that prove precision is improving.
 Work at the level of the technology. Read the rule syntax, question the entropy heuristics, understand why a scanner missed something, and challenge engineering with informed alternatives.
 Use AI to compress the distance between question and answer. Pull your own data, prototype your own flows, synthesize research and competitive input yourself, and bring conclusions rather than requests for someone else to investigate.
 Build the case for where AI belongs in the product: triage, rule generation, remediation guidance, and reducing the human review burden per finding.
 Partner with engineering, security research, threat intelligence, Field, and GitLab's own Security team, who are one of your most demanding users.
 Communicate in writing, asynchronously, with enough precision that a distributed team can act without a meeting.
 What you'll bring
 Domain depth in application security, vulnerability management, or security research. You have worked on or adjacent to scanners, detection content, threat intelligence, or SDLC security tooling and you know how these products actually get evaluated in a bake-off.
 Technical credibility sufficient to earn the respect of a security engineering team. You do not need to have written the scanner, but you should be able to reason about detection logic, data pipelines, CI integration, and the tradeoffs between coverage and noise.
 Commercial reasoning. You start from revenue mechanics, buyer motion, and competitive displacement, then work inward to product decisions. Candidates who reason only from feature lists outward are not a fit.

 Judgment under ambiguity. You bring structured options and a recommendation instead of escalating an open question.

title: Product Manager – Operations Systems (m/f/x)
description:
**Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet?**
We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.
Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet.
### **The Role**
We are looking for a **Product Manager** **to join our Product team and own the internal, backend-heavy products behind our operations.**
Every item rebuy sells has been through our hands. Before a pre-owned book, DVD, or game reaches a customer, it has been bought in, received, identified, tested, graded, stored, picked, packed, and shipped. The systems that run this flow are the focus of this team, and the users are the hundreds of colleagues in our operations teams.
You will own the tools and services behind inbound processing, grading and quality control, fulfillment, and returns. Your users are warehouse operators, graders, pickers, and operations leads. Your customers are, in the end, every rebuy buyer and seller who relies on the condition and delivery promise we make.
For this role we need someone who is genuinely detail-oriented, who reads the data before forming an opinion, who understands systems and data flows end-to-end, and who can translate operational reality into precise requirements and measurable outcomes.
As a Product Manager you work hand in hand with operations leadership, team leads, engineering, and data to deliver measurable efficiency and quality improvements. You will spend time on the floor with the people who use your products, translate their goals and constraints into a roadmap you own, build the business case with unit economics together with operations and finance, and negotiate scope and timing with engineering. Improvements are co-created with the people who run the operation, not handed to them.
### **Key Responsibilities:**
* **Drive domain product roadmap:** Translate ops strategy (throughput, unit cost, quality, lead time) into a 6–12 month roadmap with the Strategy Manager and Ops Product Lead. Make and document trade-off decisions with ops leaders
* **Understand operational reality:** Spend time at the warehouse mapping processes and data flows end-to-end to uncover system gaps and unmet needs early
* **Drive data-backed decisions:** Analyze KPIs, pull data, avoid measurement traps, and connect feature changes to unit economics improvements
* **Write precise requirements:** Specify business rules, edge cases, data models, state transitions, integrations, and failure modes for engineering
* **Ship iteratively without disruption:** Sequence releases safely using pilots, feature flags, parallel runs, change management, and pre-defined metrics
* **Collaborate across teams:** Engage in technical discussions and manage scope, time, and urgency trade-offs with tech and ops leads
* **Build stakeholder buy-in:** Align ops, CS, tech, finance, and leadership on shared metrics via clear written communication
### **Requirements:**
* **3+ years of experience in product management**, with a focus on backend, internal, workflow, or operational products (for example warehouse, logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, order management, inventory, marketplace operations, fintech back-office, or similar)
* **Hands-on data skills**: you can work fluently in an analytics environment, build your own analyses, define metrics rigorously, and spot when a number is misleading
* **Strong attention to detail**: experience writing precise specifications covering business rules, edge cases, data models, and failure modes, and catching problems before they reach production
* **Systems thinking**: you can map a multi-step operational process and the data flowing through it, identify bottlenecks and inconsistencies, and reason about second-order effects of a change
* Experience collaborating with engineering on technical decisions, including integrations and data migrations, and negotiating scope and time-to-market trade-offs
* Clear, structured communication skills, written and verbal, with the ability to build buy-in with operations team leads, engineering, and product leadership
* Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate daily work such as analysis, writing, and prototyping
* Fluency in English and German
### **Location:**
* Berlin
* Hybrid model (Must be willing to have regular presence at our operations sites located in Rudow)
### **Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy:**
* Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time.
* Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome.
* Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed.
* Use employee discounts on rebuy.de, sustainable products at Futurebens, offers for sustainable micro-mobility and massages directly in our office.
* Have fun at our legendary team and company events.
* Use our mental health offers as part of a cooperation with Nilo.
* Take care of your work-life balance with 30 vacation days.
* At rebuy all people are welcome and supported! We would like to talk, regardless of age, disability, national and social origin, skin color, religion, gender identity and sexual orientation. Just be who you are.

description:
BE - Ardo Headquarters
others
Permanent contract
Ardo is an internationally growing family-owned company with expertise in frozen vegetables, herbs, and fruit. With more than 3,200 colleagues across 16 production, packaging, and distribution sites in 7 countries, we deliver high-quality plant-based products to customers in over 100 countries every day.
Our greatest strength? Our people. Every day, our colleagues bring passion, craftsmanship, and an entrepreneurial mindset to help bring the very best of nature to millions of consumers. Whether you work in production, logistics, engineering, sales, marketing, or a support function, everyone contributes to the same goal. We share a passion for our customers and for quality, driven by results, and each of us plays a part in making a difference.
By managing the entire value chain, from seed selection and cultivation to processing, packaging, distribution, quality, innovation, and flexibility are at the heart of everything we do. This enables us to respond quickly to emerging trends and the evolving needs of our customers.
Sustainability is not an ambition for tomorrow, it is a responsibility we embrace today. We continuously invest in sustainable farming practices, energy-efficient processes, and strong, long-term partnerships with growers, suppliers, and customers. Together, we are building a healthier future for our planet and for generations to come.
Working at Ardo means being part of an international family where collaboration, respect, commitment, and entrepreneurship go hand in hand. It is a place where your talent is valued, where you can grow and develop, and where you help preserve the best of nature every single day.
### **Here’s what you’ll do:**
As part of our Product Management team, you will act as the central orchestrator of the product development and launch process within the private label products. You ensure that every new or updated product moves smoothly from concept to market readiness. You translate commercial ideas into operational execution, connecting Sales, R&D, Supply Chain, Packaging and Master Data teams to deliver products on time, on spec and in full.
Your key responsibilities are:
* You coordinate and contribute to commercial decision-making by providing analytical and strategic input.
* You link private label initiatives to broader market research and category management insights, ensuring alignment with market trends, customer strategies and company priorities.
* You coordinate all steps necessary to ensure a timely and flawless launch.
* You take ownership of OTIF launch performance, data quality and product setup lead times.
* Proactively you identify bottlenecks, standardize workflows, and propose process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
* You challenge existing processes and contribute ideas for assortment optimization, packaging efficiency and cost effectiveness.
* You support the future rollout of a Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) or similar digital platform by contributing user insights and data requirements.
* You provide transparency to management and sales teams on product status, risks and upcoming initiatives.
* You monitor key metrics such as launch success rate, time-to-market, data accuracy, ensuring performance visibility and continuous improvement.
### **This is where you recognize yourself:**
We are looking for an experienced professional with the following qualifications:
* You have a Master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Supply Chain, IT or related field
* You have a minimum of 5 years’ experience in Product Management
* You have strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills, capable of managing multiple timelines and cross-functional priorities
* You are an excellent communicator who bridges technical, commercial and operational perspectives
* You are process-minded and detail-oriented, ensuring consistency and efficiency in workflows and data
* Familiarity with private label product development or co-manufacturing is a strong asset
* Experience with SAP is an asset
* You speak Dutch and English fluently, knowledge of German of Spanish is a plus
* You embody Ardo’s core values by being customer-focused, taking ownership, acting with passion, and leading with authenticity
### **What’s in it for you?**
We offer you the opportunity to be part of an authentic and sustainable international company, with real growth opportunities and the freedom to actively participate in shaping the business and the opportunity to develop professionally. You will receive a full remuneration package in line with the level of this position. We care for our people and create family-friendly surroundings by offering you the flexibility to work 2 days/week from home.
Would you like to hear more about Ardo? Check our career page here: www.ardojobs.com.

title: Senior Product Manager, Global Year-End
description:
**Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.**
Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.
**Part of something bigger**
Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.
Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.
We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.
**Your hiring experience matters**
Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.
If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.
#### **The Tax & Year-End area at Shine**
The Tax & Year-End area is a brand-new area at Shine with a dual mission: building the pan-European tax & year-end engine, and building a winning product for tax advisors and CPAs in Germany. German accounting and tax is a highly specialized domain, and building the right product requires more than generic product expertise. We need someone who can understand the tax advisory profession in Germany and help us turn that expertise into a stellar product.
#### **Your role as Senior Product Manager, Global Year-End**
The Tax & Year-End area is built around two core teams: **Global Year-End**, which takes accountants from raw books to approved annual accounts, and **Global Tax**, which takes those approved figures all the way to a filed and accepted tax return.
As Senior Product Manager, Global Year-End, you own the first half of the engine: the closing process. You lead the product side in a cross-functional team of engineers, design and accounting domain experts building a multi-country year-end module, natively integrated with the common ledger underlying Shine and able to run on top of other accounting systems. Germany comes first, with France close behind and Spain next. You will work hand in hand with the Senior PM for Global Tax: your output is their input.
##### **Your responsibilities will include:**
* **Own the Global Year-End strategy and roadmap** — from closing preparation to signed annual accounts
* **Build the closing workflow** — checklists, period locks, review and sign-off between advisor and client, all in one place.
* **Automate the standard adjustments** — accruals and deferrals, provisions, inventory and year-end reconciliations, so advisors spend their time on judgement, not data entry.
* **Build one year-end engine, not three products** — define what is shared (closing workflow, adjustment framework, statement model) and what is local (GAAP rules, charts of accounts such as SKR03/SKR04, taxonomies, filing formats).
* **Own the handoff to Global Tax** — define the contract between approved accounts and tax returns so figures flow through without re-keying.
* **Serve two segments on one engine** — a first priority comprehensive solution for tax advisors and CPAs, and a second priority simplified, guided closing for business owners in Shine Micro.
* **Make AI a core capability** — anomaly detection in the books, suggested closing entries, automated year-end reconciliations and draft explanations that advisors can review and approve.
* **Run deep discovery with advisors** — shadow Kanzleien during closing season, map where time is lost today, and turn that into a sharp, prioritised backlog.
* **Orchestrate across the ecosystem** — partner closely with Global Tax, Core Accounting, Advisor, the common ledger teams and the local products in France, Germany and Spain.
##### **What success looks like:**
* German tax advisors close their clients' year end-to-end in Shine, from raw books through to E-Bilanz submission.
* Time to close per client drops measurably, with a growing share of adjustments suggested automatically and accepted.
* Approved accounts flow straight into Global Tax with no manual re-entry.
* The engine architecture is proven multi-country, with France live or in beta on the same foundation.
* Micro customers can complete a simple year-end on their own with confidence.
Job located in Berlin, Germany with possibility of remote working days
#### **About you**
* **You are a seasoned product manager** — 5+ years building complex B2B SaaS, ideally in accounting, ERP, tax or other regulated domains, with a track record of taking products from discovery to adoption.
* **You have good accounting fundamentals** — you have a good understand of double-entry bookkeeping, charts of accounts, and how a ledger turns into financial statements.
* **You think in platforms** — you can separate what is shared from what is local across countries and turn that into a scalable engine.
* **You are technically fluent** — comfortable discussing data models, ledger integrations, taxonomies and APIs with engineers.
* **You are AI-fluent** — you use AI in your own workflow and think critically about where AI should change how closing work gets done.
* **You care about precision** — annual accounts must be correct, auditable and trusted, and you design for that.
* **You communicate clearly** — with engineers on system design, with advisors on workflow needs, and with leadership on trade-offs.
* **You are fluent in English**; German is a big plus.

Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision — “ Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day .”— we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 110,000 employees.
Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.
Our values guide how we work:
 We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
 We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
 We Commit to doing things the right way — growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation
 Shape the Connectivity and Integration Backbone of the Future in Renal Care
 We are transforming from a device-centric organization into an integrated digital health ecosystem combining medical devices, software, AI-enabled insights, data-driven services, and connected care solutions.
To accelerate this transformation, we are seeking a Global Product Manager Digital Products – Connectivity & Ecosystem Interoperability (m/f/d) to drive the next generation of interoperability, connectivity, and healthcare integration capabilities across our future global digital ecosystem.
In this role, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, and commercialization of key digital connectivity and integration products that enable seamless data exchange, workflow integration, and ecosystem interoperability across clinics, devices, software platforms, and healthcare systems.
You will work at the intersection of digital health, interoperability, connected devices, edge computing, and healthcare IT infrastructure — helping shape the future foundation of connected renal care.
 Your tasks
 Product Strategy & Ecosystem Enablement
 Define product vision, strategy, value proposition, roadmap, and business models for connectivity and interoperability products
 Ensure alignment between dedicated products, overall portfolio and business unit strategy
 Drive next generation products of scalable connectivity and interoperability solutions enabling connected care workflows and ecosystem growth, including:
 Edge device capabilities and related on-prem / cloud SaaS deployment strategy
 EHR / HIS integration solutions
 HL7 / FHIR based interoperability solutions
 Next generation peripheral integration solutions
 Product Definition, Commercialization & Go-to-Market
